actual_reader_interval: worker time.perf_counter immediately before/after reader.score_pair. Includes complete-pair token counting/tokenization, actual tensor tokenization, input validation and CPU tensor preparation, stock CPU model execution, logits extraction and Python full-threeway softmax/decision. It is not an isolated model kernel interval.
context_plus_reader_plus_native_query: Saved raw-structure component sums include packing/provenance/token-count preparation, complete reader call, and native query time for actual_native. They exclude whole-document partition/BGE embedding, index/model initialization and other worker overhead.
